description: Use when the user wants hotel recommendations or wants hotels compared. Returns up to 20 hotels compared on the same criteria, each with area, nearest station, amenities and price where known; empty fields mean unknown, not bad. shortlist_url is a page you can share with the user comparing the top results side by side. Find hotels by city, name or preferences (query words also match amenities, e.g. "pool", "breakfast"). Cities in Staylist's catalogue return hotels that each have an approved partner booking link (Trip.com, Klook), with a score (Staylist AI score, or the Trip.com guest rating where there is none; see sample_estimate.score_source), star class, amenities, check-in/out times and nearby transport where collected, pros and cons, and a sample_estimate (a previously observed nightly price, not a quote for the dates). Other cities use a live provider with indicative prices for an explicit stay. Supply both dates or neither. One room, 1–8 adults and up to 6 children. Use get_booking_link for the traveler's link. Never send names, email addresses or payment details.

checkin.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format; provide both dates or neither
